role: KnownDEV exploratory finite candidate comparison; protocol written after predictor error review, not independentTEST or preregistration
task: Same map and initial root, choose from9 geometric routes and2 speed requests, stage-constant alpha0/.5/1
fixed_alpha: Each diagonal alpha pair fixed; evaluate all9routes x2speeds =18 queries. Speed-only is exactly fixed alpha0 under this definition, report alias rather than invent a distinct method.
joint_budget18: Nine deterministic offsets0..8; for each route0..8 and speed_index0..1 choose stage-alpha pair index(route+3*speed_index+offset)%9 in lexicographic pair ordering. Each offset has18 queries; report all offsets, no best-offset selection.
selection: Among raw admitted candidates minimize predicted goal_time_s; deterministic tie alpha_pair,route,speed. No actual success or trajectory used for selection.
oracle: Existence of actual successful candidate in same queried set; no fabricated optimal time
comparison: Report selected actual task outcome, no-plan, feasible-but-rejected, query count, all per-root choices; raw model gates not certified/calibrated; both before/after exposure predictors
identity: Before comparing confirm candidate initial physical states agree and map grouping from source manifest, not filename guesses
